caseName: Devore v. West Virginia Board of Dental Examiners
caseNameFull: DEVORE v. WEST VIRGINIA BOARD OF DENTAL EXAMINERS
attorneys: William C. Beatty for appellant., C. Donald Robertson, Attorney General of West Virginia, and Thomas B. Yost, Assistant Attorney General, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Douglas

is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
